commentaire: Compatibility zone of this repository for DSH. The compatibility tester (the first step of every install/upgrade) refuses any jump outside it unless --force. The plugin's version is the short git hash (no internal semver). Versions compare segment by segment (0.1.10 is later than 0.1.7). Only min and max are read by the gate; `testees` records what was actually played.
note: 0.2.2-rc.1 (npm `latest` and `next`, published 2026-11-04) VALIDATED on 2026-11-05 on isolated instances only (own HOME, DSH_HOME and npm prefix, profile = APFS clone of the real one; the real engine, profile and port 3080 were not touched): `dsh-lifecycle upgrade 0.2.2-rc.1 --force` ends « update succeeded » (robot boot check passed), the boot shows the same two known lines as alpha.2 (`1 entry did not activate`, `codex ... already registered`), the surface audit gives the same 5/11 contracts and 0 break as the real machine on alpha.2, and 25 live checks were replayed side by side with an alpha.2 sandbox cloned the same way: 21 give the same status at once, the 4 others (mobile, mobile-remote, terminal, usage) were replayed and give the same lines on both engines once the state is equal (the first terminal difference was only that the robot honours the real machine's satellites list, which lacks kybernos-terminal, so the route was not mounted; with the bundle activated it passes 7/7 on rc.1; `mobile` is unstable on BOTH engines, 0 to 9 failures from one run to the next on alpha.2, and a 390 px screenshot of the home page and of Settings on rc.1 shows no break; `usage` fails identically on both: the sandbox has no server). NOT replayed: the other ~90 checks of the battery (language family, calls, onboarding, team, skills, automations: they need a server or fail on both engines), the real GUI on the real machine, Linux arm64 headless. Known on 0.2.2-rc.1, from the release notes: it moves several plugin interfaces (tools.resolve/executable and the prompt assembly, `agent.model` is the only way to pick a model, Session Projection registration is async, PTC SSH protocol 2 to 3, a cancelled `run_code` answers ABORTED, Web Fetch accepts private addresses) and none of our bundles failed to activate on it; `docker/engine-locks/0.2.2-rc.1` is the robot's own tree; DSH needs Node 24.9 or later on this line (alpha.2 too: the hosted image Dockerfile is still on node:22). ADOPTED on the real machine the same day at the owner's request (« Oui, adopte »): `dsh-lifecycle upgrade 0.2.2-rc.1` (no --force once the range was widened; photo ~/.dsh/lifecycle/photos/20261105212955., `dsh-lifecycle rollback` restores the alpha.2 profile files and the engine link must then be put back on 0.2.2-alpha.2 by hand), no DSH session was running (`actives` said `others: []`, no session file touched in 10 minutes), the real `dsh web` was restarted with its own environment (41 names kept as found, pid 29760 to 57369), the boot shows the same two known lines (`1 entry did not activate`, `codex ... already registered`), plugin routes answer 200 (the `automation-load` route needs an Origin header, a bare curl gets 403), doctor says « server started after the installation » with 5/11 contracts and only `@local/dsh-subagent-maison` undeclared (as before), and the real home page and Settings page were looked at (no page error). The old DSH process, still running on alpha.2 code while the profile moved to rc.1, logged 40 « incompatible with dsh 0.2.2-alpha.2 » lines until it was restarted: restart right after the upgrade. 0.2.2-alpha.2 (npm `alpha` tag; `latest` still points at 0.2.1-rc.5, a later date on a lower line) VALIDATED on 2026-10-30 on an isolated instance only (own HOME, DSH_HOME and npm prefix: the real engine, profile and port 3080 were not touched): `dsh-lifecycle upgrade 0.2.2-alpha.2 --force` ends « update succeeded », every bundle mounts in about 2 s, and the boot shows the same two known lines as rc.2 (`1 entry did not activate`, `codex ... already registered`). One profile row blocks DSH 0.2.2: `- id: tools / config: mode: !!js process.env.DSH_TOOLS_MODE || 'native'` (hand edit of 2026-09-17 in ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml). `dsh-lifecycle upgrade` now removes it by itself for a target at or above 0.2.2-alpha.2 (migrerProfil; a `tools` row that carries anything else is left and named; the photo keeps the old file), on this machine it was deleted by hand before the robot learned to. alpha.2 split the native and PTC executors into `dsh-tool-executor-native` and `dsh-tool-executor-ptc`, `tools` takes no `mode` any more and DSH stops at boot with « 2 required plugins did not activate »; on rc.2 the row is harmless and `native` is the default anyway. Three gaps found on the isolated instance, fixed in the plugins and checked on alpha.2 AND on rc.2: the Settings nav (248 px) overlapped the page because alpha.2's panel is a grid with a 188 px first column (kybernos-plugin client.js); alpha.2 draws Settings flat (title strip, nav, header, page), so the phone list-then-page layout lost its back bar and its page measured 0x0 (kybernos-mobile); alpha.2 scrolls a Settings cell into view when it takes focus, so a real mouse click of the live helpers missed its target (scripts/live-page.mjs, check-accent-live). Replayed on alpha.2 after the fixes: mobile 21/21, accent 61/61, animations 4/4; of 48 targeted live checks the other non-passes are the same on rc.2 in the same sandbox (timeouts and sandbox limits, not the engine). New or native in alpha.2 (27 packages changed): « More » entry menus and plugin detail pages with third-party update and rollback, message quotes, action cards, experimental forge/worktree, liveshare, computer-use (macOS), the locales ja es fr de ru pt-BR (our language runtime follows DSH's language and reloads the page once when it differs), narrow-screen Settings. The engine shows its own « Update available 0.2.1-rc.2 » toast (it compares itself with `latest`). FULL live battery replayed on alpha.2 (116 checks, isolated sandbox, same code): 51 pass, 65 do not. The 65 were replayed on a rc.2 sandbox with the same profile: 50 give the same status and the same failing lines (sandbox noise: no account, no keys, no server console), 5 of the 6 that passed only on rc.2 passed again on a fresh alpha.2 (state left by earlier checks), and the 6th, check-settings-nav-i18n, used Spanish as its language to translate, which alpha.2 now ships natively (DSH then shows its own Spanish, the row reads « Idioma »): it now uses Italian and passes 9/9 on alpha.2. No product regression found. Not settled: 9 checks that fail on BOTH engines but with slightly different lines (automation-load, language, language-disk, language-creation, language-run, phone-apps, skills-learned-v2, team-folder, theme), and the checks of the language family, which still use Spanish. Not replayed: Linux arm64 headless (scripts/install-linux-arm64.sh takes this max as its default). ADOPTED on the real machine the same day at the owner's request: the profile `tools` row was deleted by hand first (original kept in ~/kybernos-archive/dsh-alpha2-adoption-2026-10-30/), `dsh-lifecycle upgrade 0.2.2-alpha.2` (no --force once the range was widened; photo ~/.dsh/lifecycle/photos/20261030140637., `dsh-lifecycle rollback` restores the rc.2 profile files and the engine link must then be put back on 0.2.1-rc.2 by hand), no DSH session was running, `dsh web` restarted with its saved environment, boot shows the same two known lines, plugin routes answer 200, and the real Settings page was looked at (nav column 248 px, no overlap, no page error). The doctor still reports 5/11 engine contracts and the `@local/dsh-subagent-maison` bundle as undeclared, both as before. 0.2.1-rc.2 (npm `latest` since 2026-10-17; alpha.5 and rc.1 were skipped) VALIDATED on 2026-10-19 on an isolated instance only (own HOME, DSH_HOME and npm prefix: the real engine, profile and port 3080 were not touched): engine tree installed with the robot manifest, profile pins moved to rc.2 by the robot alignment, the same 86 packages as alpha.4 and no patch to re-apply. Boot: the same single known line as alpha.4 (`codex ... already registered`), provided the four hand-made links node_modules/dsh-subagent-{opencode,gemini,qwen,hermes} (the maison providers, outside the profile manifest) are in place: a pnpm run that purges node_modules removes them and DSH then reports 5 entries not activated (seen once, because the sandbox pnpm store differs from the real one; the real profile keeps them). Doctor: 5/11 contracts as before. Live checks replayed: footer 261, auto 17, cards 13, changes 76, animations 8; account-menu has the same 3 failures on alpha.4 and rc.2 (not caused by rc.2). NOT replayed on rc.2: language, calls, motion, onboarding, team, skills; ADOPTED on the real machine the same day at the owner request: `dsh-lifecycle upgrade 0.2.1-rc.2` (no --force once the range was widened; photo ~/.dsh/lifecycle/photos/20261019103142, `dsh-lifecycle rollback` restores alpha.4), the 9 sessions running in DSH were interrupted, `dsh web` restarted with its saved environment, boot shows the same single known line, the four maison provider links survived, plugin routes answer 200. Found on the real GUI: the model menu of Auto floated 226 px above the picker (rc.2 re-places the menu itself, our fixed lift of the panel height then doubled it); fixed in kybernos-auto/client.js by measuring the overlap, checked on the real GUI (gap 8 px) and with a simulated old engine. 0.2.1-alpha.4 (the `alpha` dist-tag; alpha.3 was skipped) ADOPTED on 2026-10-15 at the owner's request: installed on the real machine by `dsh-lifecycle upgrade 0.2.1-alpha.4 --force` (photo ~/.dsh/lifecycle/photos/20261015144744 kept: `dsh-lifecycle rollback` restores alpha.2), the robot's own boot check passed with the same two lines as alpha.2 (`1 entry did not activate`, `codex ... already registered`), and the real `dsh web` was restarted on it and smoke-tested in the GUI (new-chat page, pinned rows, session icons, source chips, plugin routes 200). Replayed since, the same day, on an isolated instance (own HOME and DSH_HOME, profile cloned from the real one, engine tree 0.2.1-alpha.4, every bundle of this checkout): the sidebar footer, scripts/check-footer-live.mjs (the one-button footer, both menus, the links, the Upgrade dialog and each refusal of Subscribe, the guard on DSH's account launcher: 95 checks), and the instance booted with all bundles mounted. What it found: the trigger of the settings seat is DSH's ACCOUNT launcher (slot `settings.launcher`), whose click opens an account popover (Settings / Feedback / Sign in), not the Settings dialog, so every plugin that clicked it to reach Settings opened that popover; the launcher's code is the same on 0.2.1-alpha.2 (diffed, not replayed there), so the defect is probably older than alpha.4. Fixed in the core plugin (the `window.__kbOpenDshSettings` seam and a capture-phase guard on the launcher) and in the footer (its one button opens our menu). Still NOT replayed on alpha.4: the live checks (language, calls, motion, onboarding, team, skills) and the surface audit beyond the doctor's. The previous note follows. 0.2.1-alpha.2 prepared on 2026-10-11 and ADOPTED by the owner on 2026-10-12, on purpose although `latest` is still rc.2 and this is an alpha: the machine's `dsh` (/opt/homebrew/bin/dsh, a link into ~/.dsh/kybernos/moteur/0.2.1-alpha.2) and the web profile's packages are on it, and the real `dsh web` runs on it. Played on an isolated instance (own HOME and DSH_HOME, engine tree installed with the robot's own manifest, profile pins moved to alpha.2): the surface audit finds 0 break among its 11 probes (same as rc.2); the instance boots after TWO edits to the PROFILE, not to this repository: (1) the `tools` entry sets `mode: both`, which alpha.2 no longer accepts (`native` | `ptc` only; `ptc` collapses the native tools into run_code), so DSH stops with « 1 required plugin did not activate » until it is set to `native` (the `both` of 2026-09-17 was a workaround for the glm-5.3-flash route, which encodes untyped object parameters as strings: to re-measure); (2) `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector` is no longer a bundle (its profile part is `dsh-experimental-inspector-profile`) and the native tool `subagent_claude_code` now collides with the `kybernos-workers-claude-code` entry, which no longer activates. 10 live checks replayed against the same checks on rc.2 gave the same result (8 OK; the 2 others fail identically on rc.2). NOT played in that first run: language, calls, motion, theme, onboarding, team, skills. Played on alpha.2 since, on isolated instances (2026-10-12): the theme boot sheet, the account's custom instructions, the Auto chat fallback (also played on rc.2) and the phone layout (kybernos-mobile). Still NOT played: language, calls, motion, onboarding, team, skills. 279 of 281 engine packages changed (chat and conversation UI, subagent, session controller, theme), 8 removed (Claude Code and Codex hook bridges, webhook runtime, invariants, schedule bundle), 11 added (persistent terminal, session search and query, session titles, worktree and working-directory tools, schedule tools, translator, inspector). Profile edit (1) is in the real profile (`mode: DSH_TOOLS_MODE || 'native'`); edit (2) was not re-checked there. The rest of the live checks is still to do. 0.2.0-rc.2 validated on 2026-09-26. Installation: package @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 with the override « dsh-client-ui-settings-account: 0.2.0-rc.1 » (never published); the 15 profile packages moved to 0.2.0-rc.2 by pnpm. The three retouches were re-applied then (queue-move by a three-way merge with zero conflict on six files, 56/56 assertions; workspace-pins, whose anchors all land; goal-affichage, one adapted anchor) and have since moved into the plugins (patches.json). 0.2.0 traps: reopening a session restores the LAST active tab (Chat/Workflows/workflows-v2), so check-goal-affichage forces the Chat tab; a page left open serves the old module graph: reload before any UI proof. History: 0.1.7-rc.2 validated 2026-09-26; 0.1.7-alpha.1 validated 2026-09-22 (the « broken boot » of the day was a profile left on 0.1.6). General traps: the agent-team-web-profile package is stopped (alignment queries the registry); retouches are per version, and « absent » in a retouch check means an anchor to place, not a failure.
